name: Quest City Tour

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen — light sage, the reading surface between the deep patina bands. Never pure white behind long text outdoors.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, the answer input and leaderboard rows sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet wells: the connection banner, locked buttons, empty photo slot, table header row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card dividers only (1.5:1 — never the only edge of a control).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons: 3.9:1 on `surface`, 4.2:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on `surface` (14.8:1), `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `gold-100`, `gold-300` and `gold-500` (7.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — rules, captions, meta — on `surface` (7.4:1), `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (6.5:1). Still dark enough for sunlight.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `patina-600`, `patina-800` and `theatre-600`.

tokens.name: patina-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind success states and the correct-answer moment; `patina-800` text on it (8.7:1).

tokens.name: patina-300
tokens.usage: The copper-patina roofs of Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, as photographed. Decorative only (2.4:1 on `surface`): illustrations, cover, progress-bar track on light grounds.

tokens.name: patina-600
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: primary buttons, links, progress fill on light grounds. `ink-inverse` on it 6.3:1; as text on `surface` 5.9:1.

tokens.name: patina-800
tokens.usage: Game-header ground, pressed primary buttons, focus ring (9.3:1 on `surface`). `ink-inverse` on it 10:1.

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Ground for penalty tags and opened hints, and the player's own leaderboard row; `ink` or `gold-700` on it.

tokens.name: gold-300
tokens.usage: The gilded domes in overcast light. Penalty total and accents on `patina-800` (6.7:1); confetti and cover blocks.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Full gold: time-warning header ground (with `ink`, 7.2:1), progress fill on `patina-800` (4.5:1), celebration marks. Never as text on light grounds (2.1:1).

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Gold as text: penalty amounts ('+10 min') on `surface` (5.8:1) and `gold-100` (5.5:1).

tokens.name: theatre-100
tokens.usage: Ground of inline errors (wrong answer, upload failed); `theatre-800` text on it (8.5:1).

tokens.name: theatre-500
tokens.usage: The red walls of the Ivan Vazov National Theatre. 'Curtain' moments — the finish and time's-up hero bands, cover blocks. `ink-inverse` on it 5.4:1.

tokens.name: theatre-600
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on `surface` (6.4:1) and `theatre-100` (5.6:1); destructive button ground with `ink-inverse` (6.9:1).

tokens.name: theatre-800
tokens.usage: Error message text on `theatre-100`; pressed state of `theatre-600` fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Re-brand hook: primary actions read this, not `patina-600` directly. A host swaps it for their own colour (keep ≥4.5:1 with `on-accent`).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Re-brand hook: pressed accent, header ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` and `accent-strong`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element (≥4.5:1 on all grounds it lands on).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: finish, time's up, correct-answer moment.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Game name on Welcome, landmark name on Landmark info.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Modal titles, section titles, screen titles on error pages.

styles.name: riddle
styles.sample: Golden domes shine over the square that bears my name.
styles.usage: The riddle text only — read while walking, so one step larger than body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tasks are played in order. The clock runs without pause.
styles.usage: All running text, hints, tourist info, rules. Also the answer input (never below 16px — iOS zooms).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, tag text, leaderboard team names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta only: progress label, photo privacy footnote, table headers. Never for rules or penalties.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: The header clock and leaderboard times — fixed-width so ticking digits never jump.

styles.name: timer-xl
styles.usage: The team's total time on Finish.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; between stacked tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group; header inner rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (all frames); card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on a screen; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap before the primary action zone; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top/bottom air on celebration and error screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, the progress bar, table row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the answer input, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals (top corners of bottom sheets), the task picture.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Penalty tags in the header, the photo counter badge.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable (brief asks ≥44px; we round up for walking thumbs).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Persistent in-game header: clock row + progress row.

tokens.name: frame-width
tokens.usage: Primary mock frame (390 × 844); also check 360 × 740.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and leaderboard on `surface`.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet modals and toasts.

note: Values follow direction 02c "Evening Domes · Cards" (design/02c-evening-cards.html). Token names are unchanged; the usage notes still describe each token's role.
